item.title: Fixing Spring Form IllegalStateException: Target Object for 'command' Not Found
item.description:
“Fixing Spring Form IllegalStateException: Target Object for ‘command’ Not Found”

When deploying Spring MVC applications utilizing JSP form tags (<form:form>), encountering java.lang.IllegalStateException: Neither BindingResult nor plain target object for bean name 'command' available as request attribute signals a mismatch between what the form tag expects and what the controller has provided to the view. This exception typically arises because the <form:form> tag needs a backing object—a command object—to establish binding paths, and by default, it searches for an attribute named ‘command’ in the request model.

item.title: Spring Boot Controller: Diverse Methods for Serving Files for Download
item.description:
“Spring Boot Controller: Diverse Methods for Serving Files for Download”

How does one effectively stream file content, such as PDFs or other binaries, from a Spring controller method to trigger a download in the client’s browser, and what are the varying approaches available using Spring MVC features?

When serving files through a Spring controller, the primary goal is to correctly set the HTTP response headers—specifically Content-Type and Content-Disposition—and then write the file data (either from an InputStream or a byte array) to the HttpServletResponse’s output stream, or return a specific Spring type.

item.title: Solved: How to Fix Spring MVC 'No Mapping Found' Errors
item.description:
“Solved: How to Fix Spring MVC ‘No Mapping Found’ Errors”

Encountering the dreaded “No mapping found for HTTP request with URI […] in DispatcherServlet” warning, often followed by an HTTP 404 Not Found response, can be a significant roadblock when developing Spring MVC applications. This error signifies that the DispatcherServlet, the central controller in Spring MVC, could not locate a suitable handler to process an incoming web request. This comprehensive guide will delve into the core reasons behind this issue and provide actionable solutions to get your application back on track.
